findings.summary: Core launch layout failed at phone and tablet widths
findings.resolution: Responsive containment, navigation, launch-status, and headline constraints were added and passed Chromium and Firefox at 768x1024 plus mobile emulation profiles.
verification: all eleven routes had zero document overflow in every non-mobile engine profile
phone and tablet home-layout assertions passed

findings.summary: Axe confirmed 28 color-contrast failures across public routes
findings.resolution: Route-scoped foreground tokens were replaced with contrast-safe values.
verification: axe-core color-contrast returned zero confirmed violations across eleven routes in seven profiles
gradient-backed content still requires physical/manual accessibility review

findings.summary: Activation dialog and tabs had an incomplete keyboard and ARIA contract
findings.resolution: The dialog now isolates background siblings, restores opener focus, traps focus, and implements roving tabs with relationships and arrow/Home/End controls.
verification: keyboard contract passed in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, tablet, Android emulation, and iOS WebKit emulation profiles

findings.summary: Decorative verify orbit created desktop document overflow
findings.resolution: The verify route now clips and paint-contains decorative overflow without hiding functional controls.
verification: route-matrix overflow assertion passed for /verify in desktop and tablet engines

findings.summary: Skip focus, heading order, generic ARIA labels, and landmarks needed repair
findings.resolution: Skip activation focuses main, heading order is repaired, labelled generic containers use supported semantics, and floating content is contained by landmarks.
verification: axe heading-order, region, and aria-prohibited-attr checks passed
explicit generic aria-label assertion returned zero matches

findings.summary: Network lookup completion and errors were not programmatically announced
findings.resolution: Loading and completion use a polite status, failures use an alert, and the invoking button retains focus across the asynchronous request.
verification: network alert and focus assertions passed in all seven profiles

findings.summary: LaunchPage emitted a React unique-key console error
findings.resolution: Mapped title fragments now have stable keys.
verification: launch route emitted no unique-key console defect in all seven profiles

findings.summary: Two home images omitted intrinsic dimensions
findings.resolution: Both images now publish their source width and height, lazy loading, and asynchronous decoding metadata.
verification: home image intrinsic-dimension assertion passed in all seven profiles

findings.summary: Physical mobile, graphical Linux, assistive-technology, and independent certification remain unavailable
evidence: iPhone and Android results are Playwright emulation, not physical-device evidence
WebKit automation is not installed mobile Safari
no screen-reader session or independent reviewer was used
findings.remediation: Run and publish the same matrix in a physical device and assistive-technology lab with independent review.
